title: Undertow and Interior
author: Astrid Eriksen
blurb: Emrys Ashgrove, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
